slide1.title: Plan trips together
slide1.description: Create a trip, invite your group with a single link — no account required for guests. Everyone can contribute from day one and chat right inside the trip.
slide2.title: Activities, Voting & Calendar
slide2.description: Add activities, vote with must-do, like, skip, or group-blocker, and see everything laid out on a shared calendar. The global calendar shows every trip at a glance so nothing overlaps.
slide3.title: Getting There
slide3.description: Flights, rentals, and public transport all in one place — vote on options, track who's on which ride, and attach each traveler's ticket right to the booking.
slide4.title: Expenses & Analytics
slide4.description: Log who paid what — in any currency — attach receipts by upload or camera, flag business costs on expenses, bookings, or transport, and settle up with one tap. The Analytics tab shows your total cost share across every trip.
slide5.title: Shopping & Packing
slide5.description: Shared shopping lists, recipes that auto-fill your cart, and a packing list for every member — private or shared.
